subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests exist for the Live Preview feature. The test/unit/ directory does not exist. The review criteria require new features to have corresponding vitest unit tests mirroring the src/ path. At minimum, tests should verify that the Contentstack Stack options include a live_preview block with enable=true and a management_token, and that CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN is validated in the env-check block.
issues.suggestedFix: Create test/unit/services/contentstack.test.ts (or similar) asserting: (1) options.live_preview.enable === true, (2) options.live_preview.management_token is sourced from process.env.CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN, (3) the env validation block throws when CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN is missing. Run with `~/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.0/bin/node ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run` to confirm passing.

issues.description: The live_preview config block includes `host: CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST`, which is not part of the prescribed minimal fix. The RCA prescribes only `management_token` and `enable`. While the Contentstack SDK may accept a `host` property in live_preview, reusing the delivery API host for the preview host may be incorrect — Contentstack live preview typically requires a separate preview host endpoint. If the SDK uses this host for WebSocket or polling connections, pointing it at the delivery API host could cause silent failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Either remove `host` from the live_preview block (matching the prescribed fix exactly), or introduce a dedicated `CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST` env var and named constant if a separate preview host is genuinely needed. Verify against Contentstack SDK documentation that `host` is a valid live_preview property and what value it expects.

issues.description: CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN was added to the mandatory env validation block that throws on startup. This is a potential regression: existing deployments (CI, staging, production) that do not have CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN set will now crash on boot with 'Missing required environment variables'. The verification criteria require 'Existing behavior related to this area is unchanged (no regression).'
issues.suggestedFix: If live preview is optional (can be toggled off when the token is absent), make the validation conditional: only require CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN when live preview is enabled (e.g., via a CONTENTSTACK_LIVE_PREVIEW_ENABLED flag). Alternatively, coordinate with DevOps to ensure the env var is deployed before merging. At minimum, document the new required env var in the project's README or .env.example.

issues.description: The `live_preview` config uses `host: CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST` which is a named constant — good. However, `CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` is destructured from process.env at the module top level (line 28) rather than being explicitly validated before use. If process.env is undefined (edge case in some test runners), the destructuring `const { ... CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN = '' } = process?.env || {}` safely defaults to empty string, but the validation block only logs the error rather than providing a descriptive message about which token is missing.
issues.suggestedFix: Enhance the error logging to specify 'Contentstack management token not provided' (already done at line 64-65) — this is adequate. No change needed unless the generic throw message at line 70 should list all missing vars. Optional improvement only.
